subject: Incremental activation & revised monthly commit — LumenData 8→16 GPU upgrade
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@lumendata.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement <procurement@lumendata.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity ask — bumping reserved pool 8→16 GPUs

Hi Avery,

We’ve seen consistent model throughput increases in prod and are ready to move forward with doubling our reserved pool from 8 to 16 GPUs at renewal. A few asks up front:

- Can you provide a revised monthly commit and an itemized quote?
- We need an activation plan that minimizes downtime and allows a staged cutover (canary traffic first).
- Are there throughput guarantees you can add to the contract for peak batches?

Procurement is looped for T&C review (cc). Ideally we’d like pricing and a target activation window by early next week — renewal is end of month.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Head of Platform Engineering
LumenData

From: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@lumendata.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Procurement <procurement@lumendata.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity ask — bumping reserved pool 8→16 GPUs

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. High level: we can support a staged activation with a 30-day phased ramp and include a throughput addendum that guarantees 14k tokens/sec aggregate for the dedicated pool (measured at the pool level, with per-request latency SLOs).

I’m attaching a first-pass quote and an activation timeline. Quick notes:
- Monthly commit (base): we propose moving to a 16-GPU equivalent commit priced at $XXX,XXX/month (line-item in attached PDF) with a 10% onboarding credit applied to the first invoice.
- Staggered activation: we’ll enable 4 GPUs at t+0, +4 GPUs at week 1, +4 GPUs at week 2, +4 GPUs at week 3. Each step includes a canary window (1–3 hours) and rollback playbook.
- SLA/Throughput: the SLA addendum covers uptime and pool-level throughput. If we miss the guaranteed throughput in any calendar month, we’ll apply service credits tied to the shortfall.

Can you confirm: 1) whether LumenData prefers a single annual commit invoice or monthly billing for the commit; 2) an acceptable kickoff date range (we have capacity the week of Sep 6).

If procurement prefers, we can deliver a DA/DocuSign-ready amendment after you confirm billing cadence.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: FW: LumenData 8→16 pricing / SLA

Avery — quick internal note before we send the amended quote:

- Margin squeeze: the 10% onboarding credit + 14k tokens/sec guarantee is aggressive for a straight 8→16 uplift. Recommend we soften the billing ramp in case LumenData asks for ongoing discounts. Option A: 2-month transitional credit (10% month 1, 5% month 2). Option B: keep onboarding one-time credit but add a 12-month minimum term on the 16-GPU commit.
- Ops burden: the staggered activation plan is fine but we should explicitly call out a 48-hour SLA for canary rollback support (assign on-call). Marissa — can CS own the cutover runbook?

If you want, I’ll draft the alternate billing language and a short runbook to include in the amendment.

Thanks,
Dev
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@lumendata.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@lumendata.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2026 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Updated proposal + activation options (LD-8742)

Alex — following our internal review I’m sending an updated package with two optional billing structures so LumenData can choose the economic model that fits your forecasting. Changes from the first pass are highlighted in the PDF:

Option 1 (preferred): Annual prepaid commit for 16 GPUs with a 10% onboarding credit applied to Month 1; 12-month minimum term. Lower unit price, higher upfront commitment.

Option 2: Monthly billed commit (16-GPU equivalent) with a 2-month transitional credit (10% then 5%) to smooth the impact. Slightly higher unit price but preserves cash flow.

We also formalized the throughput addendum: pool-level guarantee of 14k tokens/sec measured via our standard tracer. If we miss the monthly guarantee, service credits apply (formula in SLA_Throughput_Addendum). For the activation plan: Marissa will own the cutover runbook and assign the CS on-call for rollback windows; we provide an ops checklist and a 24–48 hour emergency response SLA during the staggered ramp.

I’ve attached: updated quote (RDW_LumenData_Quote_v1.pdf), activation timeline (Activation_Timeline.xlsx), and the SLA addendum (SLA_Throughput_Addendum.docx).

Next steps: 1) confirm preferred billing option; 2) procurement to confirm T&C items; 3) sign amendment (DocuSign) to schedule activation during the Sep 6–10 window.

If you want, I can also schedule a 30-minute runthrough with Marissa and Dev to walk the plan.

Cheers,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Avery — thanks for the fast turnaround and the two options. Procurement prefers Option 2 (monthly billed commit with the 2-month transitional credit) because our cash flows are constrained this quarter. We also accept the throughput SLA language pending a minor redline around measurement window (we’ll propose a 5-minute sampling window instead of 1 minute).

Please route a DocuSign amendment and I’ll get Procurement to countersign. We are targeting Sep 8 for the first activation step. Also, Marissa — if you can pick an initial 4-GPU canary time (Pacific business hours) that works for your on-call, we’ll lock the date.

Appreciate the flexibility — excited to ramp.

— Alex
